purpose: Canonical tag vocabulary across every catalog. ANY entry in any catalogs/<lane>.json file MUST use values from these enums (or NULL). The verifier rejects unknown tags. The feed filters/ranks on these.

regions._note: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for primary base. Diaspora artists use 'diaspora-XX' where XX = current base country.

languages._note: ISO-639-1 codes for the artist's primary performance language. Multi-lingual artists pick their dominant.

roles.producer: beats and arrangements; may or may not perform
roles.dj: club + festival circuit; may produce as well
roles.dancer: choreographer / performer; often crosses into instruction
roles.instructor: teaches a style; school owner / festival circuit
roles.label: label-run channel; aggregator of multiple artists
roles.lifestyle: broad creator (food/travel/culture) tied to lane region

subgenres._note: Optional finer label. Helps cross-tag a creator that fits multiple lanes (e.g. afrobeats + amapiano crossover).

tier._note: Followers + cultural weight tier. Set by verifier from platform-reported follower count; defaults to null until verified.

entry_schema.name: canonical full name
entry_schema.lanes: array of one or more lane keys (e.g. ['genre/kizomba','travel/angola'])
entry_schema.platforms: object mapping platform → canonical handle string (no @, no URL). YT can be @handle or UC...channel ID.
entry_schema.subgenres: array of subgenre tags from this taxonomy
entry_schema.rationale: ≤ 25-word reason this artist matters in their lanes
entry_schema.verified_at: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp set by verifier
entry_schema.follower_counts: object mapping platform → follower count (set by verifier)
